html_content:
Music Lessons in West Island Montreal — Private Instruction for All Levels

From Beginners to Advanced!

Our courses are taught by highly qualified teachers in professional studio classrooms at our Pointe-Claire location. Programs are customized based on students' age, specific goals and music genres, ranging from rock to R&B to jazz and classical. Serving students from Pointe-Claire, DDO, Kirkland, Beaconsfield, Pierrefonds, and Dorval.

Our 16 Music Course Offerings

Voice Lessons
Piano Lessons
Guitar Lessons
Drum Lessons
Bass Lessons
Violin Lessons
Cello Lessons
Keyboard Lessons
Music Initiation
Saxophone Lessons
Trumpet Lessons
Flute Lessons
Clarinet Lessons
Rock Band (semi-private)
Garage Band (semi-private)
Recording Programming

Why Choose Our Music Programs

  • Professional concerts – some of the largest amateur concerts in Canada
  • RCM exam preparation with internationally recognized credentials
  • Band performance opportunities with experienced instructors
  • Customized programs based on age, goals, and music genres
  • Over 50 years of teaching excellence in the West Island

Start Your Musical Journey

Book a free trial lesson today! Call 514-428-5080 or contact us online.

Located at Plaza Pointe-Claire, 269 St-Jean blvd, Suite 101, Pointe-Claire, QC H9R 3J1.
